summary: Rendering helper that draws an outlined rectangle: obtains the global rendering context via GlobalAccessor_5150, issues an initial border draw through DelegationWrapper with width (a7-a6) and height (a5-a4), then, while a3 > 0, repeatedly draws the four edges with two alternating color masks (v18 = a1 & 0xFF000000 | a2 & 0xFFFFFF, v19 = a1 & 0xFF000000 | ~a2 & 0xFFFFFF) via FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform, shrinking the rectangle by 1 px per side after the first iteration. Called by ShortComputation_7260.

operations.description: Call GlobalAccessor_5150() to obtain the global rendering context object (v11).
Call DelegationWrapper(v11, a6, a4, a7 - a6, a5 - a4, a1): initial border draw with x=a6, y=a4, width=a7-a6, height=a5-a4.
If a3 <= 0, the whole edge-drawing loop is skipped and the function returns a3.
Compute the two alternating color masks: v18 = a1 & 0xFF000000 | a2 & 0xFFFFFF and v19 = a1 & 0xFF000000 | ~a2 & 0xFFFFFF.
Do-while iteration over v20 from 0 up to a3-1; each pass draws all four edges, then increments v20 and repeats while v20 < a3.
Inside the loop, if v20 > 0, shrink the rectangle by 1 px per side: ++v9 (top), --v7 (bottom), ++v10 (left), --v8 (right).
Draw the top edge: FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform(v10, v9, v8, v9, v18, context) from (left,top) to (right,top) with color mask v18.
Draw the right edge: FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform(v8, v9, v8, v7, v18, context) from (right,top) to (right,bottom) with color mask v18.
Draw the bottom edge: FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform(v10, v7, v8, v7, v19, context) from (left,bottom) to (right,bottom) with color mask v19.
Draw the left edge: FloatVectorWithConditionalTransform(v10, v9, v10, v7, v19, context) from (left,top) to (left,bottom) with color mask v19.
Return the final iteration counter: result = ++v20, i.e. the value a3 on completion.
